title: 5G NR LDPC real-time and research enablers
description:
## Goal

Bring up 5G NR LDPC as the headline benchmark for the `gf2-sim`
pipeline: BG1 + BG2 with all 8 lifting sets, rates
{1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6}, tuned to a real-time decode rate on
gfx1030 for at least one (BG, lifting set, rate) configuration.
Add a comparison harness against aff3ct / IT++ and ship
researcher onboarding examples.

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing-blocked on
the DVB-T2 application story (proves the pipeline at production
scale). Existing memory entry flags per-`i_LS` correctness as a
known trap — the BG-table task must verify against 3GPP TS 38.212.

## Deliverables (themes)

- 5G NR LDPC base graphs (BG1, BG2) + per-`i_LS` shift tables,
  verified vs 3GPP TS 38.212 for rates {1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6}.
- 5G NR preset (typestate builder).
- GPU LDPC BP kernel tuning to real-time decode rate on gfx1030;
  documented measurement vs spec PRB rates for the chosen
  (BG, lifting set, rate) configuration.
- Comparison harness vs aff3ct / IT++ on a shared benchmark
  suite (DVB-T2 + 5G NR LDPC AWGN curves).
- Researcher onboarding: `examples/`, rustdoc walk-throughs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Real-time decode rate met on at least one
  (BG, lifting set, rate) configuration on gfx1030 with
  documented receipt under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/5g-nr-realtime.md`.
- [hard] aff3ct / IT++ comparison curves on at least one
  configuration committed under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/`.
- [hard] Onboarding examples + rustdoc cover both the DVB-T2 and
  5G NR presets via the typestate builder.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; turbo, polar, and fading-channel
extensions are out of scope.
